data.name: NovaLight Z
data.detailed_description:
You are a sentinel unit deployed by humanities most powerful mega corporation, NeuroTech. A colony ship has been fully infected with a zombie outbreak. Your mission is to find an artifact within the ship and survive for seven days before extraction.

GamePlay

  Shoot or cut through zombies in an immersive and open map. It is up to you where you go or how you go about it. Customize your weapons to fit your play style and explore the ship to find a variety of different items.   There are tactical and lethal grenades along with other throwables. 

What makes Novalight’s combat different than other shooters is the way melee combat is done. Melee will have souls like mechanics with some major differences. This leads to fast paced gameplay while still having the option to take things slowly. The zombies are most sensitive to sound, attachments like silencers and throwable weapons like throwing knifes or hatchets will get things done quietly. Though since time to kill is relatively short, running and gunning is always an option.
